AGENDA
  PLANNING COMMISSION
  JUNE 14, 2023

UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE, MEETINGS WILL BE CONDUCTED PURSUANT TO THE PROVISIONS OF ASSEMBLY
BILL 361, WHICH ALLOWS PLANNING COMMISSION MEMBERS TO PARTICIPATE FROM A REMOTE LOCATION
WITHOUT LISTING A PHYSICAL LOCATION. TO PROVIDE COMMENTS DURING A MEETING: YOU MAY ATTEND
THE MEETING, SEND AN EMAIL TO: planning@norwalkca.gov OR JOIN THE ZOOM MEETING BY CALLING 1-
(669)-444-9171 OR USING THE ZOOM APP; MEETING ID: 929 283 6465# 1054 DURING THE MEETING TO SPEAK
ON AN ITEM. THE MEETING MAY BE VIEWED ON FIOS CHANNEL 32 OR CHARTER CHANNEL 3 OR ON THE
CITY’S WEBPAGE AT: https://www.norwalk.org/city-hall/meeting-agendas-393.
  SPECIAL MEETING
  NORWALK CITY HALL/COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  AND VIA TELECONFERENCE
  6:00 PM

  Rosa Barragan, Chair
  Linda Lopez, Vice Chair
  Kim Apodaca, Planning Commissioner
  Gabriel P. Garcia, Planning Commissioner
  Luis Navas, Planning Commissioner

 Public Comment: Comments may be made in person, submitted via email at: planning@norwalkca.gov, or through the video/teleconference
 during the designated time on any item on the agenda or on any other matter within the jurisdiction subject to the rules of decorum described in
 Norwalk Municipal Code §2.08.020. The maximum time allowed is three minutes.

 Pursuant to provisions of the Brown Act, no action may be taken on a matter unless it is listed on the agenda, or unless certain emergency or
 special circumstances exist. The Planning Commission may direct staff to investigate and/or schedule certain matters for consideration at a future
 Planning Commission meeting.

 Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services
 offered by this City, please contact the Community Development Department, (562) 929-5744. Assisted listening devices are available at this
 meeting. Ask the Secretary if you desire to use this device. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available
 in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability. Notification of at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed
 will assist the City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.

 Note: Any writings and/or documents provided to a majority of the Planning Commission regarding any item on this agenda after it has been posted
 will also be made available for public inspection.

 Writings and/or documents are available for inspection, by request in the Community Development Department, City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard
 during regular business hours, 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday – Thursday; telephone (562) 929-5744. You may also contact the City Clerk via
 e-mail at recordsrequests@norwalkca.gov.

CALL TO ORDER
  FLAG SALUTE

Commissioner Apodaca

 ROLL CALL OF MEMBERS

 MINUTES

1.  MEETING MINUTES
  Staff recommends that the Planning Commission approve the minutes of the Special Meeting of May 31,
  2023.

 PUBLIC HEARING

2.  Zone Change (ZC) No. 2022-02/ Tentative Parcel Map (TPM) No. 2022-03/ Precise Development Plan
  (PDP) No. 2022-04/ Director Approval Request (DAR) No. 2022-05 – ZC: To rezone a portion of the project
  site from Automobile Parking (P) to Restricted Commercial (C-1). TPM: To merge the existing six (6) lots
  into one (1) lot. PDP: To permit the construction of a new two-story, 8,715 square foot commercial building.
  DAR: To permit a six percent reduction (two spaces) from the required number of parking spaces.
  Environmental: Consider and find that the project is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act
  (CEQA) pursuant to Section 15303 (New Construction or Conversion of Small Structures) and 15332 (In-
  Fill Development Projects). The subject property is generally known as 12217 Rosecrans Avenue, located
  on the north side of Rosecrans Avenue and east of Norwalk Boulevard (also known as Assessor’s Parcel
  Number (“APN”) 8056—018-006, -005, -038, -023 -024).
  Staff Recommendation: That the Planning Commission:
  (1) Adopt Resolution No. 23-12 recommending City Council approval of Zone Change No. 2022-02; and
  (2) Adopt Resolution No. 23-13 to approve Tentative Parcel Map No. 2022-03 subject to the Conditions of
  Approval contained in Exhibit “A”; and
  (3) Adopt Resolution No. 23-14 to approve Precise Development Plan No. 2022-04 subject to the Conditions
  of Approval contained in Exhibit “A”; and
  (4) Adopt Resolution No. 23-15 to approve Director Approval Request No. 2022-05 subject to the Conditions
  of Approval contained in Exhibit “A”; and
  (5) Consider and find that the project is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act pursuant to
  CEQA Guidelines Section 15303 (New Construction or Conversion of Small Structures) and Section 15331
  (In-Fill Development Projects).

 ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

 ADJOURNMENT

I, John P. Ramirez, AICP, Director of Community Development/Secretary, hereby certify that the foregoing
agenda was posted at City Hall not less than 72-hours before the start of the meeting and forwarded to each
member of the Norwalk Planning Commission and to the following newspapers: Herald American, Los Cerritos
Community News, Norwalk Patriot, and Whittier Daily News, all on June 8, 2023.

John P. Ramirez, AICP
Planning Commission Secretary

 Planning Commission, June 14, 2023  Page 2 of 2
